card.name: Small words before wrongdoer or attacker terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (an, by, of, to, for, anti) that sit just before a word about an attacker, spy, criminal or crime. Seen in web text on security, forgery, treason and punishment.

modes.label: Security and spying
modes.description: Linking word right before an attacker, spy or snooper is named.
modes.example: it's likely that my encryption algorithm may only need to delay<< an>> attacker 24 hours by which time

modes.label: Crime and punishment
modes.description: Linking word after a conviction or punishment term, before the offence.
modes.example: was convicted<< of>> treason by a military court for passing on

modes.label: Anti-forgery and prevention
modes.description: Word that leads into a countermeasure against wrongdoing.
modes.example: incorporate some of the latest<< anti>>-forgery methods.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words for perpetrators, crime and aggression, and slightly raises words about reliability and prevention.
